status: Method declared; baseline executable. Training and sharded execution require their implementation/resource freeze; no automatic training from a baseline pass.

arms.parent: Unchanged Granite 4.1 3B with the common tool runtime.
arms.update: Update existing q_proj and v_proj matrices in layers 32..39. Model topology and active backbone parameter count unchanged. Keep the accepted parent available for rollback and routing; its storage is charged.
arms.addition: Keep backbone unchanged. Add LoRA rank 16, alpha 32, dropout 0 to q_proj and v_proj in layers 32..39. Normal zero-output initialization; seed 27092026. Do not merge into the backbone. This adds learned parameters, not a second complete backbone.

expert_training.objective: Teacher-forced assistant decision tokens only. Tool results and user/system/prompt tokens have label -100. Use validated tool trajectories from train split only. Identical decision-window schedule and target tokens for both trained arms; no truncation.
expert_training.checkpoint: Terminal step 128 only. Save optimizer/RNG, all trainable tensors, source/data/tokenizer and execution roots. No best-checkpoint shopping.
expert_training.compute_control: Same examples, targets, update count and declared GPU-time cap per trained arm. Count actual GPU seconds, memory and tokens; these do not imply exactly equal FLOPs. Reject a cost advantage that relies on uncharged parent features, failed work or routing rollouts.

integration.staging: Freeze the trained arm before fitting its gate. Gate training uses integration only, not protected/development/confirmation answers.
integration.features: Frozen parent final-layer hidden state at the first assistant-generation boundary of the episode. Original user request, system instruction and tool definitions only; no project document contents until tools read them, no task/family/split IDs. Record token/prompt roots.
integration.gate: One logistic linear binary gate (2560 weights plus bias), zero initialization, L2-normalized features with epsilon 1e-6, AdamW lr 0.001, weight decay 0.01, 128 updates, batch 8, seed 27092027; threshold 0.5, exact tie selects parent. Same recipe for update and addition.
integration.labels: Run parent and trained arm to completion on each of the 64 integration episodes. Positive only when trained arm succeeds on every round and parent fails; otherwise parent. Labels use this training partition only. Report class counts. With no positives use constant parent; with no negatives use constant trained arm. Otherwise fit the declared gate. The degenerate rule is fixed here, not chosen after evaluation.
integration.activation: Select parent or trained arm once at the first request of a bounded workspace episode; keep that selection through its follow-up. Tools and all arguments are still generated automatically. This is episode routing, not per-token MoE or arbitrary lifelong conversation routing.
integration.accounting: Charge parent feature prefill, all label-generating rollouts, gate fit, and rejected work. Vanilla LoRA changes prefix states; use fresh candidate KV caches after selection. No unverified cache reuse.
integration.ordinary_requests: Outside this workspace API, retain the unchanged accepted parent. This explicit public operation boundary is not evidence of automatic general-domain module discovery. General conversation/other tool APIs retain their own evaluation requirements.

development_gate.protected_parent_successes: Every successful baseline development episode, fixed by the baseline result root before training. Original 18 assistant anchors also remain required.

confirmation_gate.opens: Once, only after both trained controls finish and candidate passes development. If update arm failed execution or comparison is missing, do not open.

sharding: Passing complete graph must undergo the Granite-specific A4 conformance/recovery contract before native activation. Existing Llama partition implementation is not Granite-compatible by assumption.

budget.note: The later ceiling is not an AWS allocation. Exact hardware, package hashes, prepared training windows and memory measurement must be committed before a paid training run. Existing user authorization covers completing that preparation; no account permission request is introduced.

stop_rule: Publish failed gates unchanged. No opened-final method shopping, automatic relaunch, quality-paid issuance or silent serving change. A failed third-party adapter benchmark is not a prerequisite for this new contract.
